intervals: minor third up (E5->G5): the lift of a spoken question
perfect fifth down (G5->C5): falls onto the tonic, a settled answer
motif.rhythm: short-short-long; onsets 0, 110, 240 ms; C5 rings into a small room; 80 ms release
motif.why: All three notes belong to one C major triad, so the figure is consonant and calm. The rising minor third imitates question intonation, the drop of a fifth to the tonic imitates a declarative answer: 'question -> answer' in 0.7 s. Fundamentals 523-784 Hz sit in the band phone speakers reproduce; no sub-bass, no percussion hit.
